$comment: Agent dashboard nudges. Copy only: numbers come from AgentNudgeStats (see index.ts). A nudge is eligible when every `when` rule holds AND every {placeholder} in its title/body has a value. Money placeholders render with the viewer's currency already attached (e.g. 'UGX 12,000'), so never write a currency before them. Rules: gt, gte, lt, lte, eq, ne take numbers; exists takes true/false. `hour` is the Kampala hour (0-23). Ranks are among agents with an agent_collections row today, ordered by amount collected today. Terminology: Rent Plan (never loan), Supporter (never lender), Returns (never interest/ROI).
